authorization.acceptance_slice: Exercise the accepted AsteroidWorld coverage-over-time/stale-coverage measurement under exactly two declared constant rotation-rate regimes using a fixed synthetic observation schedule, producing deterministic measurement evidence and focused tests without selecting or comparing survey policies.
stop_conditions: Stop if the slice requires changing quest state, canonical memory, consolidated beliefs, contracts, schemas, delegation law, or CI/security policy.

Stop if implementation requires irregular/tumbling rotation, configurable shadow physics, terrain, seasonal geometry, or another new environmental assumption; this authorization is limited to two constant rotation rates already representable by AsteroidWorld.
Stop if choosing, comparing, or interpreting independent versus survey policies becomes necessary.
Stop if the fixed synthetic observation schedule cannot be stated explicitly and kept identical across both rotation regimes.
Stop if real mission evidence, external/public claims, or protected scientific interpretation is required.
Stop if another implementation PR or unconsumed authorization already owns this acceptance slice.
authorization.next_action: Use the existing constant-rate AsteroidWorld and accepted stale-coverage primitive to create the smallest deterministic two-rotation-regime coverage-over-time measurement with an identical synthetic observation schedule, add focused tests and optional machine-readable output, open exactly one implementation PR, run mandatory checks, and stop before policy comparison, irregular rotation, or scientific interpretation.
